keyDates.text: Pentagon deadline: 30 named universities must complete foreign collaboration audits or risk losing federal research funding eligibility.
DHS fixed-period admission rule takes effect, ending 'Duration of Status' for F-1 and J-1 visa holders. Major compliance deadline for all international student offices.
Public comment deadline for ED's proposed accreditation overhaul NPRM (30-day window opened Aug 20). Institutions should file comments to influence final rule.
FAFSA opens for the 2027-28 academic year.
Most Early Decision and Early Action deadlines for Class of 2031. Common App has been open since Aug 1.
ED target date for publishing final accreditation rule, with implementation proposed for July 1, 2027.
Federal government funding expires under the Senate-passed continuing resolution (passed Aug 8, 90-6). House and Senate must reconcile their CR versions.
ED Secretary McMahon's deadline for all universities to post public 'statements of principle' on admissions, free speech, and intellectual pluralism.
